name: wire-connection-draw
intent: A wire stroke-draws via pathLength 100 in 180ms, then snaps with a width pulse to LINKED.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Wire appears fully drawn as LINKED immediately

acceptance: SVG line uses pathLength 100; stroke-dashoffset animates 100→0 in drawMs 180
After draw, snapMs 90 width pulse then status LINKED with endpoint pulse
Replay resets dashoffset to full before redrawing
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows LINKED immediately with animations disabled
